en:
Did everyone cross the bridge? Okay then,
let's head to the mansion together.

I just came here to see you guys off...and
my hand accidentally slipped!

I-It wasn't on purpose at all!
I-I-It was an accident!

You keep talkin' shit like that, you'll only
ever attract ugly bitches!

Do you wanna spend the rest of your
life surrounded by ugly bitches, dumbass!?

Tch...that's not even an insult.
I'm famous for attracting ugly people!

I've...met a lot of people up till now, but
I've never met someone so messed up...
Seriously, that girl is so much trouble!
Oh, sorry... There was one more person here.

What are the people in the chapel going to do?
Now they have no way to get across.

Oh, you're right. You can only log out 
from the salon in the mansion.

Well, maybe Miu can fix it later. Let's just
get to the mansion already.

We'll deal with them later. First we gotta
find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>...
I can't imagine what it could be.

<CLT=cltMIND>All I can do is hope that it
means a way out...
